issue_context.title: Redirect tablet-related error notifications to OpenTabletDriver's website
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

When starting the game, it displays a message saying "device:failed to set device feature: 02-02"

### Screenshots or videos

![1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/113616487/190432061-ffb532f5-737b-4fc3-8011-fea5892a4b46.png)

comments: "Failed to set device feature" is an OpenTabletDriver-side issue. Will keep this open to track redirecting the notification to there.

I've spent some time coming up with something better for this just so we don't allow raw `OpenTabletDriver` logs entering user notifications, and I've came up with the following: (with the last notification directing [here](http://opentabletdriver.net/Tablets) on click). Icon is very not final, but it's the closest here. @peppy would like to hear your thoughts on this before I consider opening PRs.

review_comments:
This is quite ugly, but is the best way to:
 - keep this method self-contained and allow for splitting (by not moving `notfyOnWarning` to a field and bind tablet bindable when game loaded),
 - and also catch any tablet logs that were reported prior to the game being loaded (rather than calling this method once game is loaded, at which point warning/error from a connected tablet may not be visible).

The point of this logic is to keep notifying the user on warning when switching tablets (albeit the notification doesn't clearly state which tablet raised it). This could alternatively be resolved by splitting this to a `Component` that binds to the event on constructor and binds to tablet bindable on BDL.

Based on the comment above, I'm still not sure what this code is doing in the first place. Is it a debounce? For what?

This should probably be mentioned in an inline comment on `notifyOnWarning` itself.
Yeah, to assign colours to notifications in `OsuGame`.
Oh, I see. For some reason I thought that was in a separate class or something.
